feature_name: BIOS to UEFI boot type conversion
summary: Converts a VM instance boot type from BIOS to UEFI to support secure boot.
extended_definition: Converts a VM instance boot type from BIOS to UEFI to support secure boot.

supporting_pages.title: "Migrate individual VMs \_|\_ Migrate to Virtual Machines \_|\_ Google Cloud\
evidence_snippets: Convert BIOS to UEFI Enable this option to convert the OS boot type of a VM instance from Basic Input/Output System (BIOS) to Unified Extensible Firmware Interface (UEFI).
However, you can also just convert the boot type from BIOS to UEFI, without using secure boot.
To see the list of operating systems that support the conversion, see the BIOS to UEFI conversion supported column in Supported operating systems .
